record.body:
## Description

R10: `orchestra view roadmap` groups open and promoted `composer:idea` records by area. Existing views must render unchanged.

## Approach

In orchestra/views.py `_group_key`, apply the empty-value fallback to `group_default` only when it is set; otherwise keep the previous behavior `str(payload.get(group_by, subject))`. Add a unit test that `_group_key` for the plan view returns an empty string for phase "".
record.subject: fix-view-group-key
